extension.summary: Watch live sports, 24/7 channels, and replays from Sportsurge & StreamEast
extension.description: Kodi add-on for Sportsurge & StreamEast. Features high-res visual category art, dedicated LIVE NOW section, league sub-filters (NFL, NBA, EPL, F1), one-click Kodi 21 buffer optimizer, quick channel zapping & multi-game switcher, auto-updates on Kodi startup, 24/7 live TV networks, full match replays with Real-Debrid / AllDebrid, StreamEast multi-source fallback (1080p 60fps), and smart auto-play with preferred host selection.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on does not host or distribute any video content. It merely parses publicly accessible web links.
extension.news: v1.3.0: - Custom 512x512 visual artwork & icons for Wall, Poster, and Card view modes. - Dedicated "LIVE NOW (Happening Right Now)" top-level section. - League & competition sub-filters (NFL, CFB, NBA, WNBA, NCAAB, EPL, UCL, La Liga, MLS, F1, NASCAR, MotoGP). - One-Click Buffer & Speed Optimizer tool for Kodi 21 (Firestick 128MB vs PC/Shield 256MB). - Quick Channel Zapping & Multi-Game Switching (remote Next/Prev buttons cycle live matches). - Combined one-time welcome greeting and patch notes screen.
